You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How much does Jessica pay toward all her debts in one year when paying 50% more than the minimum monthly payments? Jessica's student loans have a minimum payment of $300 per month. Jessica's credit card has a minimum payment of $200 per month. Jessica's mortgage has a minimum payment of $500 per month. Jessica wants to pay 50% more than the minimum monthly payments.
